rules.title: Known stalkerware app
rules.explain: This app matches a known stalkerware product by its signing certificate or package. Apps like this are sold to monitor another person's phone.

rules.title: Someone opened your canary link
rules.explain: A private link placed in your own notes was opened from a device that is not yours, which means someone is reading your messages.

rules.title: Hidden app that can read your screen
rules.explain: This app can read everything on your screen and what you type, it was installed from outside an app store, and it hides its icon. Legitimate apps rarely do all three.

rules.title: Screen reader that uploads while your screen is off
rules.explain: This app can read your screen and sent data out while your screen was off, a pattern typical of monitoring apps.

rules.title: Keyboard app with broad access
rules.explain: A keyboard app can see everything you type. This one has not been seen misbehaving, but it is worth a look if you did not install it yourself.

rules.title: Screen reader you turned on
rules.explain: This app's accessibility access is explained by its being a screen reader, an assistive tool you or someone turned on for you.

rules.title: Parental-control app
rules.explain: This app's powers are explained by its being a known parental-control product.
